purpose: [hc-crooty] y slice leaf (crooty_y v7 = 11 leaves): y_s -> yp -> yp2 -> 16 x 256 flop FWFT FIFO -> p_y, own root; replaces s81hc_cryy{e,w}_ref (11 SRAM macros, GRT-0116 x6). crooty_y (369.36 x 300.24, 11 x 128x256 SRAM in 3 columns) failed global route six times (v1-v6, GRT-0116; v6: 169 / 1,224 markers): the macro data pins sit on the vertical macro edges, so all 2,816 b turn through four 20.3-um channels (through flow 0.95 of the channel tracks, pin escape 1.17 in a two-face channel, worst cut 1.27-1.46) and <= 0.6 needs +62 um of width the slot does not have. The tile is replaced by 11 identical 256-bit slice leaves ot_s81_hc_cryys (32.4 x 300.24, hardened once): the 16-word store is 16 x 256 flops read through a register (the macro's contract), each leaf has its own clock root (5.7k sinks), reset relay and FIFO control copy; 256 b run straight N -> S (cut 0.22 through, <= 0.44 in the store); cycle for cycle the old tile (lockstep 0 / 60,000)
